name: Eurocode (recommended values)
basis: EN 1990:2002+A1:2005, EN 1991-1-1:2002 and EN 1993-1-1:2005 recommended values, no National Annex
notes: The values the Eurocodes recommend where they leave a choice to each country (Nationally Determined Parameters). A National Annex may replace any of them.

gamma_G.source: EN 1990 Table A1.2(B): unfavourable permanent actions

gamma_Q.source: EN 1990 Table A1.2(B): leading variable action

psi_0.source: EN 1990 Table A1.1: imposed loads, categories A (domestic, residential) and B (offices)

xi.source: EN 1990 Table A1.2(B) note: reduction factor for unfavourable permanent actions in 6.10b

uls_expression.source: EN 1990 6.4.3.2(3): expression 6.10, or the less favourable of 6.10a and 6.10b, by National Annex choice

uls_default.source: Almond default where the code leaves the choice open

deflection_limit_ratio.source: Not fixed by EN 1990 (A1.4.2: limits agreed per project or National Annex); span/250 is an indicative screen

gamma_M1.source: EN 1993-1-1 6.1(1) Note 2B: resistance of members to instability

imposed_floor_kn_m2.source: EN 1991-1-1 Table 6.2 recommended values: category A floors, category B
